faq.a3: Cameras, recorder, disk, cabling, supplies, connectors, mobile/remote setup and install. 4-cam home: $1.2–1.8M; 8-cam retail: $2.5–4M COP.
faq.a4: Yes: Basic $150–300k, Pro $300–600k and Enterprise $600k–1.5M+ per month, with visits, cleaning and reports.

faq.a6: Yes. All kits and WiFi cams include a mobile app (Android/iOS) with real-time video, two-way audio and alerts.
faq.q7: Do you sell only, or also install?
faq.a7: Both: supply, assembly, setup and install in capitals (1–3 days) and nationwide (3–7 days).
faq.a8: All carry manufacturer warranty plus tech support in Colombia.
